question: When and how should a virgin be worshipped in the ritual house?
premises: A virgin is the object of worship.
Worship is to be done with devotion.
The worship occurs at the end of recitation in the house.
inference: At the conclusion of recitation, one should worship the virgin with devotion in the house.
plain_english: O beloved, at the end of recitation one should worship the virgin with devotion in the house.
